title: Spinshock
tagline: Tap on the impact to blast the rival tops away

fr.tagline: Toupie contre toupie. Tape pile à l’impact pour souffler tes rivaux et regagner de la vitesse.

en.tagline: Top against top. Tap right on impact to blast your rivals away and wind your spin back up.

description: Your top spins in a beyblade dish and loses spin every second. Rival tops charge in: tap on the impact to fire a shockwave that launches them into the walls and winds your spin back up. They carry 3 to 5 shell points, so a top you blast away ricochets and comes back for more. The top's colour is the only gauge — the run ends when it blows apart.
